result.summary: The interface displays several placeholder elements and questionable data indicators that suggest an incomplete or test state.

issues.description: All restaurant listings use generic vector illustrations instead of actual food photography.
issues.suggestion: Implement a fallback mechanism to ensure high-quality merchant images load correctly.

issues.description: A badge showing a '-100%' discount is displayed on the bottom pizza item, which appears to be placeholder data.
issues.suggestion: Validate discount calculation logic to prevent unrealistic promotional values.

issues.description: The category filter chips at the top have uneven spacing, with 'Healthy' appearing truncated on some screen widths.
issues.suggestion: Adjust horizontal padding and scroll behavior for consistent chip visibility.
